name: SuperCDMS Soudan detector (iZIP array)
notes: No Soudan-specific crystal count or total mass was found by any source fetched this session or the original research pass; left unsourced rather than assumed from the later SNOLAB payload's 24-crystal figure.

placements.note: Placed at the existing site:soudan-minos-far-detector (owned by fermilab-neutrino-other): no source gives a coordinate for a distinct SuperCDMS-specific cavern at Soudan, so the shared Soudan Underground Laboratory site is reused.
placements.quote: The most recent version, located at the Soudan Mine in Minnesota, completed operations in 2015.

summary.plain: An array of cryogenic germanium and silicon crystal detectors, using an improved sensor design called iZIP, that ran in the Soudan mine in Minnesota from 2009 to 2015.
summary.technical: iZIP (interleaved Z-sensitive Ionization and Phonon) cryogenic Ge/Si detector payload operated at the Soudan Underground Laboratory, 2009-2015; an evolution of the CDMS-II detector design with substantially improved surface-event background rejection.

technology.quote: A new style of detector, with interleaved Z-sensitive Ionization and Phonon sensors (iZIP), was developed and deployed in the CDMS facility at Soudan, resulting in substantially improved rejection of surface event backgrounds that had limited CDMS-II.
technology.value: iZIP (interleaved Z-sensitive Ionization and Phonon) cryogenic germanium/silicon detectors, an evolution of the CDMS-II detector design with improved surface-event background rejection
